summary: The notebook has two notes: a foundational gradient-descent course note and a structured reading of the Transformer paper, spanning machine-learning basics and deep-learning architecture.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: A gradient-descent note covers the update rule, learning-rate intuition, and a one-step worked example.
areas.gap: Only one ml-foundations note exists; linear models, regularization, and evaluation metrics are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A reading note on 'Attention Is All You Need' covers self-attention, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: No notes on other architectures such as CNNs, RNNs, or diffusion models; Transformer coverage is the sole entry.

areas.label: Efficient Inference
areas.coverage: The Transformer note briefly flags quadratic attention cost and downstream problems like KV caching.
areas.gap: No dedicated notes on KV-cache design, speculative decoding, or quantization methods yet.
